title: How the games are really made
cover_title: The making of a Dalex game
tease: Behind the studio doors: every step from a bright idea to a tape on the shelf
standfirst: Behind the 1987 studio on these pages is a pipeline of AI coding agents, packaged skills, Python scripts, an assembler, a contention-modelled Z80 simulator and a browser emulator. Daniel Vaughan steps out of character to follow a game from an idea to a tape, with real excerpts from the records, and to show where it goes wrong.
